name: manual_7a1966
claim: Thinking tokens share the context budget with the answer: with an 8192-token loaded context a 5900-token prompt left 2292 tokens, all spent reasoning, and the reply was empty with finish_reason=length. Keep local-model prompts under about 1500 tokens, set max_tokens to context minus prompt minus margin, and split large generation jobs into small pieces.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-10 attempt to have qwen3.8 write a whole module from a 5900-token specification; generation ran about 6 to 9 tokens per second.

rationale: 2026-11-10 attempt to have qwen3.8 write a whole module from a 5900-token specification; generation ran about 6 to 9 tokens per second.
